# foundry_toolbox (Data Source)

~> **Preview:** This data source requires `"toolboxes"` in the provider's `enable_preview` attribute. Preview features may change their inputs, outputs, or behavior in any provider release without following semantic versioning.

Looks up a single version of a Foundry toolbox. Use this to reference an existing toolbox version's tool and skill configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Toolboxes are a preview feature; opt in on the provider block:
# provider "foundry" {
#   enable_preview = ["toolboxes"]
# }

data "foundry_toolbox" "my_toolbox" {
  name    = "my-toolbox"
  version = foundry_toolbox.my_toolbox.default_version
}

output "toolbox_tools" {
  value = data.foundry_toolbox.my_toolbox.tools_json
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the toolbox to look up.
- `version` (String) Version of the toolbox to look up. Use the `foundry_toolbox` resource's `default_version` attribute to look up the currently active version.

### Read-Only

- `description` (String) Description recorded for this toolbox version.
- `id` (String) Identifier of the toolbox version.
- `skills` (Attributes List) Skills attached to this toolbox version. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--skills))
- `tools_json` (String) Tools in this toolbox version, as a JSON-encoded array. Tools are exposed as JSON rather than as typed attributes because a data source only reports what the service returns; use `jsondecode` to inspect individual tools.

<a id="nestedatt--skills"></a>
### Nested Schema for `skills`

Read-Only:

- `name` (String) Name of the referenced skill.
- `version` (String) Pinned skill version, or null when the reference follows the skill's default version.
